scripts.build: npm run build -w gallery-sources && npm run build -w gallery-app && npm run build -w indexer && npm run build -w streamer && npm run build -w downloader
scripts.start: npm run build && systemctl --user start hitomi-indexer hitomi-streamer hitomi-downloader
scripts.restart: npm run build && systemctl --user restart hitomi-indexer hitomi-streamer hitomi-downloader
